questions: Should the frequency dictionary include only characters that appear in the generated string, or should it include all ASCII letters with zero counts?
Is the random string generation required to be reproducible given the same seed, or can it vary across implementations?
Should the dictionary keys be sorted in any particular order (e.g., alphabetical, insertion order)?
What should happen if length is negative? Should it raise an error, return an empty dict, or generate a string of negative length (which would fail)?
Are uppercase and lowercase letters considered distinct characters for frequency counting?
Should the function handle non-integer length values (e.g., float) by converting or raising an error?
Is the random.choice selection uniformly distributed over all ASCII letters, or can it be weighted or biased?
Should the function reset the random seed globally, potentially affecting other random calls in the program?
